name: Merciful Mandate
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, O (peace)

EFFECT

Range short (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area one living creature
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The target must show gentleness and mercy to opponents in combat. The target is unable to attack helpless opponents or create effects that deal lethal hit point damage or inflict negative levels, ability damage, ability drain, or death effects.

If the target engages in combat, it must use attacks that deal nonlethal damage, including taking a -4 penalty on attack rolls to deal nonlethal damage with a weapon that normally deals lethal damage.
